title: Security Analyst Advancement roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to deepen technical expertise, build a polished portfolio, and prepare for senior-level roles. Focuses on advanced topics, leadership, and interview readiness.

phases.title: Foundations refresh
phases.summary: Reinforce core concepts to ensure a solid base for advanced work.

milestones.title: Networking fundamentals review
milestones.outcome: Can design and troubleshoot enterprise network segments and explain traffic flows.

tasks.title: Read TCP/IP model chapter
tasks.description: Study the OSI/TCP-IP layers on the official Cisco Networking Basics guide.

tasks.title: Map a home network diagram
tasks.description: Draw a diagram of your home router, devices, and VLANs using a free diagram tool.

tasks.title: Capture packets with Wireshark
tasks.description: Run a short capture of web traffic and identify HTTP vs HTTPS packets.

tasks.title: Summarize key protocols
tasks.description: Write a one-page summary of DNS, DHCP, and ARP functions.

milestones.title: Linux command skills
milestones.outcome: Can navigate, script, and secure Linux systems used in security operations.

tasks.title: Complete Linux Basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the introductory Linux module covering file permissions and processes.

tasks.title: Write a bash log rotation script
tasks.description: Create a script that rotates syslog files daily and compresses old logs.

tasks.title: Configure sudo rules for a user
tasks.description: Edit /etc/sudoers to grant limited admin rights and test with sudo -l.

tasks.title: Review SELinux mode settings
tasks.description: Read the SELinux documentation on enforcing vs permissive modes and note differences.

tasks.title: Reflect on privilege escalation paths
tasks.description: List three common Linux privilege escalation techniques and mitigation steps.

phases.title: Core skills expansion
phases.summary: Develop deeper abilities in analysis, tooling, and response.

milestones.title: Log analysis proficiency
milestones.outcome: Can parse, correlate, and extract actionable insights from diverse log sources.

tasks.title: Read log management chapter on MDN
tasks.description: Study the concepts of log formats, timestamps, and normalization.

tasks.title: Parse syslog with jq
tasks.description: Use jq to filter login events from a sample syslog JSON file.

tasks.title: Build a log aggregation pipeline on ELK
tasks.description: Set up Filebeat, Logstash, and Kibana on a VM to ingest sample logs.

tasks.title: Create a dashboard for failed logins
tasks.description: Design a Kibana visualization that highlights repeated failed SSH attempts.

tasks.title: Reflect on false positive sources
tasks.description: Write brief notes on why certain log entries generate noise and how to tune filters.

milestones.title: SIEM tool expertise
milestones.outcome: Can configure, query, and tune a SIEM platform for real-time detection.

tasks.title: Watch Splunk fundamentals on YouTube
tasks.description: Complete the first two videos covering data onboarding and search basics.

tasks.title: Ingest CSV data into Splunk free
tasks.description: Upload a sample CSV of firewall logs and verify field extraction.

tasks.title: Write a SPL query for port scans
tasks.description: Create a search that identifies multiple connection attempts to sequential ports from a single IP.

tasks.title: Tune a detection rule to reduce noise
tasks.description: Adjust threshold values on a built-in rule and document the impact.

tasks.title: Connect with Splunk community forum
tasks.description: Post a question about rule tuning and read two replies for best practices.

milestones.title: Incident response process
milestones.outcome: Can lead an end-to-end response, from triage to remediation and lessons learned.

tasks.title: Read NIST IR 800-61r2 executive summary
tasks.description: Summarize the four phases of the incident response lifecycle.

tasks.title: Create a triage checklist template
tasks.description: Draft a one-page checklist covering evidence collection, containment, and communication.

tasks.title: Simulate a phishing email analysis
tasks.description: Examine a sample phishing email, extract indicators, and document findings.

tasks.title: Conduct a post-mortem write-up
tasks.description: Write a concise report describing root cause, impact, and remediation steps for the simulated incident.

tasks.title: Reflect on communication gaps
tasks.description: Identify two ways to improve stakeholder updates during incidents.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate real-world capability.

milestones.title: Home lab logging setup
milestones.outcome: Can showcase a fully instrumented lab with centralized log collection and alerts.

tasks.title: Provision a VM network on VirtualBox
tasks.description: Create three VMs (router, web server, client) and configure internal networking.

tasks.title: Install OSSEC on the server
tasks.description: Deploy OSSEC HIDS, configure agents on all VMs, and verify alerts.

tasks.title: Document lab architecture
tasks.description: Write a short blog post with diagrams describing the logging pipeline.

tasks.title: Share the blog on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post the article and invite feedback from security peers.

milestones.title: CTF incident report
milestones.outcome: Can produce a professional incident analysis report from a capture-the-flag exercise.

tasks.title: Complete a medium-level CTF challenge on Hack The Box
tasks.description: Solve a challenge that involves privilege escalation and log tampering.

tasks.title: Extract IOC data from the challenge
tasks.description: Identify IPs, hashes, and file paths used during the exploit.

tasks.title: Write a formal incident report
tasks.description: Structure the report with executive summary, timeline, findings, and recommendations.

tasks.title: Peer-review the report with a colleague
tasks.description: Exchange reports with another analyst and provide constructive feedback.

milestones.title: Detection rule set portfolio
milestones.outcome: Can demonstrate a curated collection of effective detection rules across multiple platforms.

tasks.title: Create 5 Sigma rules for common attacks
tasks.description: Write Sigma YAML files for brute force, ransomware, and data exfiltration patterns.

tasks.title: Convert Sigma to Splunk SPL
tasks.description: Use the Sigma converter to generate SPL queries and test them on your lab data.

tasks.title: Document rule rationale and tuning notes
tasks.description: For each rule, write a brief note on why it was chosen and how to reduce false positives.

tasks.title: Publish the rule set on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a public repository with README, licensing, and contribution guidelines.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance leadership, threat intel, and prepare for senior interviews.

milestones.title: Threat intelligence integration
milestones.outcome: Can enrich alerts with external intel and produce actionable threat briefs.

tasks.title: Read ATT&CK Navigator guide on MITRE site
tasks.description: Understand how to map detections to ATT&CK techniques.

tasks.title: Subscribe to a free STIX feed
tasks.description: Set up a pull of a public STIX/TAXII feed and store indicators locally.

tasks.title: Enrich a sample alert with intel
tasks.description: Take a logged alert and add CVE, malware family, and threat actor context.

tasks.title: Write a 2-page threat brief
tasks.description: Summarize the enriched alert, impact, and recommended mitigations.

tasks.title: Connect with a threat intel community
tasks.description: Join the Open Threat Exchange forum and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Leadership & communication
milestones.outcome: Can lead security initiatives and convey technical findings to non-technical audiences.

tasks.title: Read a chapter on security leadership from SANS
tasks.description: Focus on building a security culture and incident command structures.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock tabletop exercise
tasks.description: Run a 30-minute tabletop with peers, assigning roles and debriefing afterward.

tasks.title: Prepare an executive slide deck
tasks.description: Create 5 slides summarizing a recent incident and business impact.

tasks.title: Deliver the deck to a colleague
tasks.description: Present the slides and gather feedback on clarity and tone.

tasks.title: Reflect on stakeholder questions
tasks.description: Write notes on the toughest questions and how you would answer them.

milestones.title: Senior interview preparation
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer technical, scenario, and behavioral questions for senior analyst roles.

tasks.title: Compile common senior analyst interview questions
tasks.description: Gather questions from Glassdoor and professional blogs into a document.

tasks.title: Mock answer each question aloud
tasks.description: Record yourself responding to technical and behavioral prompts.

tasks.title: Review answers with a mentor
tasks.description: Share recordings with an experienced analyst for critique.

tasks.title: Update resume with portfolio links
tasks.description: Add the home lab, CTF report, and rule set URLs to your CV.

tasks.title: Reflect on gaps and set next goals
tasks.description: Identify any remaining skill gaps and outline a 3-month action plan.
